title: Progress lines as events

blocks.text: A crew-rostering service maximizes a score with CP-SAT and wants a chart of each solve's progress. The log's progress lines look like this:

#Bound   0.02s best:-inf  next:[300,5200] main
#1       0.03s best:4100 next:[4101,5200] main
#Done    0.09s main

`#1`, `#2`, ... announce a new plan, `#Bound` a better bound, and `#Done` the end of the search. After the time come `best:` (the best plan's value, `-inf` before any plan exists), `next:[low,high]` (for a maximization, `high` is the bound) and the worker that caused the event, sometimes followed by a comment. `#Model` lines report model changes and are not progress events.

items: `events(log)`: a list with one tuple `(kind, best, bound, worker)` per `#N`, `#Bound` and `#Done` line, in order. `kind` is `"solution"`, `"bound"` or `"done"`; `best` and `bound` are integers, or `None` when the line has no number for them (`-inf`, or a `#Done` line); `worker` is the worker's name alone.
`stopped_by_a_limit(log)`: `True` if the log has no `#Done` line.

blocks.text: A `#Done` line has no `best:` or `next:` part, so a pattern for the range, such as the lesson's `RANGE`, does not match it. Read such a line's worker as the first word after the time, as the reference does (`rest.split()[0]` on what follows the time, or `""` if nothing follows), and give it `None` for `best` and `bound`.
Skip every other line. About fifteen lines.

cases.says: each #N, #Bound and #Done line becomes one event with its plan value, bound and worker
a log with no #Done line was stopped by a limit, and one with it was not
a worker name followed by a comment in brackets is read as the name alone

origin.section: Each Progress Line Is an Event: a New Plan or a Better Bound

concepts: each progress line is a plan, a bound or the end, with the best value, the bound and the worker
